title: Rooted Realm
description: Rooted Realm is a cozy, community focused Minecraft server where players build, survive, and make lasting friendships.
body:
# 🌳 Rooted Realm

**Rooted Realm** is a cozy, community focused Minecraft server where players build, survive, and make lasting friendships.

Designed around a small whitelisted community, the server offers a relaxed survival experience with weekly events, a player driven economy, and collaborative projects that grow over time.

If you are looking for a place to settle in, build something meaningful, and become part of a friendly community, Rooted Realm is the place for you.

---

# 🌍 What Makes Rooted Realm Different

Rooted Realm is not a massive public server filled with chaos.

Instead, it is built around a few simple principles

🌱 Community first
🧱 Long term builds and worlds
🤝 Respectful trusted players
🎮 Vanilla style survival gameplay

The goal is to create a server where players know each other, collaborate on projects, and enjoy Minecraft together.

---

# 🎉 Weekly Events

The server regularly hosts community events to bring players together.

Events may include

Building competitions
Adventure challenges
Community projects
Seasonal events

These events help keep the world active and give players new ways to interact with each other.

---

# 💰 Player Driven Economy

Rooted Realm features a community driven economy where players can trade resources, services, and builds.

Whether you are

Running a shop
Offering building services
Trading rare materials

The economy is entirely shaped by the players themselves.

---

# 🔐 Whitelisted Community

To maintain a friendly atmosphere, Rooted Realm is whitelisted.

This helps ensure

No griefing or trolls
A respectful environment
A close knit player base
Long term community stability

New players are welcomed after completing a simple whitelist application.

---

# 🧭 Server Tools and Resources

Rooted Realm includes several tools to help players explore and stay connected.

### 📚 Server Wiki

A detailed wiki explains the server, rules, mechanics, and guides.

[Open the Wiki](https://rr-wiki.novacantium.co.uk)

### 🗺️ Live World Map

View the world and player builds from your browser.

[View the Live Map](https://mc.novacantium.co.uk/map)

### 🛠️ Development Roadmap

Follow the server future plans and upcoming features.

[View the Roadmap](https://trello.com/b/aJYDP27D/rooted-realm)

---

# 🌍 World Size

The survival world has a **20,000 × 20,000 block border**, creating a large but meaningful world where player builds remain connected and the landscape continues to evolve with the community.

---

# 🚪 How to Join

Because Rooted Realm is a whitelisted community, joining requires a quick application.

1 Join the Discord
2 Submit the whitelist application
3 Get approved and start playing

[Join the Discord](https://discord.gg/u5jSjG5bkn)

Applications are usually reviewed quickly and new players are welcomed into the community once approved.

---

# 🌲 Build Something That Lasts

Rooted Realm is more than just another Minecraft server.

It is a place where players build history, friendships, and worlds that grow over time.
